rules.text: reuse_campaign_id replaces settings and recipients atomically only on an owned, never-launched voice draft or scheduled campaign. A launch claim prevents replacement. SMS creation always generates a fresh ID, even if the request forwards this field. Omit it for SMS.
rules.why: Draft replacement checks campaign ownership and launch state.

rules.text: Resume covers only unattempted work in the existing running launch. Neither resume nor reuse replays completed work.
rules.instead: For another run create a campaign with a fresh ID, selected recipients and reviewed settings.

rules.text: Cancel stops eligible future work. In-progress work may finish. Deletion can wait for confirmed hang-up.

Use schedule_type=schedule and scheduled_date (YYYY-MM-DD), timezone, optional paired window_start_minutes and window_end_minutes, and window_days. The date check uses UTC. Local recipient rules, time windows and capacity still apply.
There is no scheduled_at promise of dispatch at an exact second.
rules.instead: Choose a date and a local window and track actual recipient status.

rules.text: Local window bounds are minutes since midnight. The accepted weekdays and minute range are shown below.
Voice deletion, cancellation and resume are separate operations. SMS has its own cancel and resume routes.
not_resumable means this campaign is outside the running launch state. Read its current state and create a new campaign for another run.
